decisions.reason: Changing to gravity-based feed does not alter the requirement that the bowl and dispensing connections remain leak-free.
The dispensing path must remain cleanable regardless of whether flow is gravity-based, and the source does not necessarily eliminate a removable or flushable outlet.
The candidate already records the same-message uncertainty about replacing the spout, and gravity-based feed does not necessarily eliminate an outlet with the existing location or orientation.
Gravity-based dispensing does not change the requirement to prevent liquid from reaching the electrical components.
The source changes the dispensing feed method but does not change bowl capacity, depth, enclosure size, or the stated bowl-design priorities.
